rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 3: "In the full agent picture, this is the first piece: context." "this" resolves to "first piece" in the chunk header; "None of them" resolves to "tools, goals, checks, boundaries, and loops" in the prior sentence. "the full agent picture" is the header's "picture" and the training spine vocabulary (arc-earned carve-out); it never reaches a referent outside the chunk.
line 3: "Later you add tools, goals, checks, boundaries, and loops." Closest to a callback; "Later" points forward in reading order and names the things, not another file by position.
